As a data steward, I want the Workbench case and ownership records migrated from the legacy Workbench with their ACE business keys, so that every open case keeps its owner, its queue and its history from the first day.

As a data steward, I want the agreed but unbooked treatments and their approvals migrated from the legacy Workbench, so that a restructure, settlement or deed already promised to a customer continues without a break at cutover.

As a data steward, I want the open promises and contact notes held outside EFS migrated to the case, so that no promise a customer made is lost at cutover while the EFS history itself is read from ACE.

As a data steward, I want the listings, the case asset links and the open sale instructions migrated from the legacy Workbench, so that an asset already offered for sale is not lost at cutover while the collateral, appraisal and NPA asset records are read from ACE.

As a data steward, I want the legal actions, the notices already sent and the open law firm instructions migrated from the legacy Workbench, so that litigation continues at cutover while the court case and hearing records are read from ACE.
As a data steward, I want the panel firms, their users and their open instructions migrated from the legacy Workbench, so that panel status and performance continue across cutover.
As a data steward, I want the debt sale lots and their accounts migrated from the legacy Workbench, so that a sale in flight keeps its accounts, its reserve price and its buyer.
As a data steward, I want the documents of the open cases and their extracted fields migrated from the legacy Workbench, so that the case file is complete on the first day.

As a data steward, I want the route each open case carries and the route economics baseline the Workbench calculates migrated, so that the baseline and the route history survive cutover while the COLLINS score itself is read from ACE.

As a data steward, I want the decisions taken outside the Workbench on the open cases migrated with their rule and model version and their hash chain, so that the audit trail is unbroken from the first day.

As a data steward, I want the open proceeds matches and the closures recorded in the legacy Workbench migrated, so that money already received stays matched to its case and a closed case keeps its closure reason.

As a data steward, I want the rules, the approval limits, the lists of values and the letter templates that the Workbench owns migrated as versioned reference data, so that the versions in force at go-live are the ones the business approved.
